name: app.services.sql_query_router_logic
message:
Executing SQL query using unified database service: SELECT
  a.Name
FROM artist AS a
JOIN album AS ab
  ON a.ArtistId = ab.ArtistId
JOIN track AS t
  ON ab.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
JOIN invoiceline AS il
  ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
GROUP BY
  a.Name
ORDER BY
  SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC
LIMIT 10;
